_why: THE ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the colours a project figure may use (D-16: one number is truth). The LaTeX colour file and the dark-theme map are GENERATED from this file by build-contract.mjs; never edit them by hand. Base hexes are the site's own tokens (catalog/web/tokens/phyriad.tokens.css, oxide palette): paper, muted, accent, ok, error, rule. `ink` is TeX's default black in the light theme: authors never set it. The four fill* roles are tints of a base role over the paper, so a figure has ONE accent against muted ink, never a categorical palette.
